# AUTOPILOT_JOURNAL.md

Append-only session journal for this repo's Autopilot maintenance sessions.

Each entry records one session: what was done, what failed, observations, and
hints for the next session. Do not edit existing entries. New entries are
appended at the end by the agent.

To audit all agent activity: `git log --grep="autopilot/session"`
